thesis: Canvas plus a floating main panel. layout.css owns values; this file says which token applies and what not to copy.

shell.inspectors: quiet rectangles inside main, not a second floating app

footer.corner: Open Help menu at the left (24x24 circle, 10px inset, 16x16 question-mark glyph)
footer.controls: right cluster: chat chip (while a chat is minimized) + Agent launcher + Chat history, 2px gaps, 10px from the window's right edge
footer.note: the footer has no fill of its own: canvas tone, no hairline (matches the live strip); the chip and the launcher are both 8px-radius controls that read differently — the chip is the filled surfaced one

roles.where: Inbox, My issues, nested team links
h2 next to favorite star, not a page title
Sep 6, size · date, capacity, list alerts
settings h1 in the content column
one line under settings page title

tabs.motion: no measured tab motion in the live reference; dashboard reuses lists.fold tokens (--panel-fold-duration / --panel-fold-ease) for the selected fill and text colour (accepted in dashboard 01-providers Usage share, 2026-10-03)
tabs.notSegmented: each tab is its own capsule with gap 4px; no shared track/background group around them (dashboard Usage share 7d|30d first shipped as a segmented control, corrected 2026-10-03)

emphasis.where: settings Invite, Create team, Upgrade now

controls.search: icon or quiet inline field, never a hero search

iconToggle.where: one-off on/off icon among ghost icon actions in a tool row (accepted in dashboard 05-projects draft, 2026-09-28)
iconToggle.state: aria-pressed; disabled while the toggled work is running

groupBar.plus: 24px hit target at the band end

fold.where: in-panel collapsible (milestone description); also dashboard 05-projects terminal, prompt, and file sections (accepted 2026-09-28)

implementation.contentHeight: grid-template-rows 0fr ↔ 1fr on a wrapper whose child is min-h-0 overflow-hidden (moves exactly the content height; not a fixed max-height)
implementation.fillPanel: a panel that fills the column animates flex-grow 1 → 0 plus min-height to its header height; header stays in place, only the body folds

fold.alsoUsedFor: data changes in place: bar width transitions and keyed row reorder (svelte flip, cubicOut ≈ --panel-fold-ease, 200ms) on the same tokens; every transition is off under prefers-reduced-motion (dashboard 01-providers card history and Usage share, 2026-10-03)

inspector.where: right column inside main, same surface, not a modal

bars.accent: --primary only for a status threshold (quota 60-80%), --destructive at 80%+; never for neutral share bars
bars.where: dashboard provider cards and Usage share (accepted 2026-10-03)

not: replace cached numbers on visit or revalidate

settings.measure: content column past --sidebar-width, not the first h1

lede.where: one line under a group heading (Invite links, Workspace login). A setting row may carry its own one-line description when its title alone does not say what it changes (security toggles)

formFamily.denseOptions: chips in one row, not a switch per item

groupHeader.where: settings/security group above each well (AI & Agents, MCP connectors, Invite links)

settingRow.control: end-aligned: switch, select (--select-trigger-height), input, --accent pill button, or chevron for a drill-in row
settingRow.unavailable: text block opacity 0.5 with an end label (Available on Enterprise)
settingRow.dialog: a settings dialog reuses groupHeader + well + settingRow at --dialog-cap; put the explanation on the group lede and keep rows title-only when every row in the group shares that purpose

color.model: grayscale plus restrained semantic state color

checklist: canvas sidebar; main uses --radius and --panel-inset on every side (never flush to the rail)
sidebar offcanvas slides with --sidebar-collapse-duration / --sidebar-collapse-ease; hide the rail below --sidebar-hide-below
product header is --text-heading-sm; --text-title is content identity
settings page title is --text-title weight 500 in the content column
product header actions are ghost --text-label-sm; settings may use one --primary pill at --control-height
lists: muted identifier, primary title, status dot, no card-per-row
list hover is --accent at --radius-sm inset --list-row-hover-inset; group envelope is --list-group-gap above the first row and below the last, 0 between rows
settings forms: --content-narrow, --secondary wells, gap-12 between groups

section lede only; input --control-height 6px 12px on well; select always has a default (never placeholder); trigger --select-trigger-height --accent weight 400; menu --select-menu highlight --select-item-highlight; check after label; selected row stays on trigger
dense options are chips in one row, not a switch list
reserve semantic color for state or identity; action states use --status-info, --status-highlight, --status-danger, and --status-neutral at 0.15 tint
dialog width is min(--dialog-cap, 100% - 2rem); no header/footer rule
well rows use --hairline-width inset --well-row-inset at --foreground 0.1, not --border
refresh: keep last numbers; pulse --muted --radius-md bars only on empty slots or explicit Refresh
areas split by filled boxes + --panel-inset gaps (sectioning), not hairline stacks; code/terminal panes use sectioning.codeBox; folds use lists.fold.implementation

displayOptions.where: toolbar right cluster, second disc; floats over the panel
displayOptions.state: open in the draft (catalog shows the popover)
displayOptions.chrome: menuSurface; 302px wide; rows 32px; toggles 24x14; property chips 24px

issuePanel.where: docked right of the list, inside the list container (aside)

board.kind: column slots with no gap; each column is a 46px header tab that fades down the full column
board.scrollbar: native horizontal; live scrollbar-color: lch(37.275 1.2 272) transparent

displayOptions.rows: Columns / Rows / Ordering (the list variant says Grouping / Sub-grouping)
displayOptions.extra: Board options section (Show empty columns) + a Reset | Set default for everyone footer
displayOptions.source: live team-all toolbar > Display options while the Board layout is active

hiddenColumnsRail.where: trailing region inside the board scroller
hiddenColumnsRail.content: collapsed tabs for statuses hidden by "Show empty columns: off"

displayOptions.enter: 58ms, scale 0.98 → 1 from 100% 0, opacity 0 → 2 (clamped to 1 when painted)
displayOptions.exit: 207ms, scale → 0.98 at 49ms, exponential opacity decay (≈26ms half-life)

filterMenu.box: 261.6x707, anchored 77px right of the Add filter disc (right edge on the panel edge)
filterMenu.rows: 37px input row + 6px-inset list: 19 items of 32px, 4 separators of 12px
filterMenu.animation: same measured spring as displayOptions, on the popper container (frames 0.1971/0.983943 → 0.2919/0.985839 → 0.4418/0.988835, origin 129.2px -3.9px)
filterMenu.submenus: hover-expanded, opening left with their measured border-box sizes; instant (no animation measured); 32px rows with an optional 16x14 select box (label 60px in) vs navigation rows (label 38px in); component ref/team-filter-popover.svelte, data ref/filter-submenus.ts

popovers.sharedChrome: menuSurface + menuMark (bg rgb(33,33,34), border rgb(50,51,54), radius 12, ring shadow) — the filter menu matches the store's measured menu chrome exactly; icons inline in ref/filter-icons.ts

agentChat.component: ref/app-footer.svelte (shared: shell.svelte mounts it on all three ref pages)
agentChat.source: live linear.app footer + floating agent chat (CDP 9201, 2026-09-14)
agentChat.chrome: agentMark in ref/chrome.ts; screenshot evidence in ref/linear.app/popovers/agent-*.png
agentChat.toneRelation: the panel's 0.8px rim is the same tone as the chip's active fill (--accent rgb(35,35,37) vs the measured rim rgb(35,36,38)); the panel body is one step darker (--secondary rgb(26,26,27)) inside a 0.8px ring of --background rgb(9,9,10)
agentChat.enter: 58ms, scale 0.98 → 1 from 100% 100% (the footer chip's corner), opacity 0 → 2 (clamped to 1 when painted)
agentChat.exit: 207ms, the same measured curve as displayOptions (scale → 0.98 at 49ms, exponential opacity tail)
agentChat.states: chip visible while a chat with content is minimized; `Close chat` / the chip's ✕ removes the chip; the launcher opens the panel (title `New chat` when the session is empty)

sectioning.between: filled boxes separated by --panel-inset gaps; do not stack hairline dividers between areas
sectioning.columnSeam: no hairline between the main column and the inspector column; a resize handle shows only on hover/focus

codeBox.where: code block in project overview; terminal and prompt panes
codeBox.header: h-8 tab row, --hairline-width --border under it only while open

inspectorStack.fileListsInside: plain: no fill, no border; header `label count ▾` + trailing actions

asideToggle.how: grid column width → 0; the aside keeps its own width and slides out clipped, inert while closed
